title: hieracium sagittatum subsp. hepatiphyllum
intro: Hieracium sagittatum subsp. hepatiphyllum, commonly known as Mountain hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating liver and gallbladder issues, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain hawkweed are attributed to its ability to stimulate bile production, improve digestion, and support liver function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
